  obtain d state ug_state where iterate: "(d, state, ug_state) =
      iterate x (init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈) init_ug_state"
    and st: "st = stabl state" and sigma: "sigma = σ state"
    using assms(2) unfolding solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
  have c_empty: "called state = {}"
    using called_same(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate]
    unfolding init_state_def
    by simp
  have well_init: "TD_side.well_infl_stabl (init_state⦇called := called init_state - {x}⦈)"
    unfolding init_state_def TD_side.well_infl_stabl_def fmlookup_default_def
    by simp
  then have well_result_state: "TD_side.well_infl_stabl (state⦇called := called state - {x}⦈)"
    and x_stabl: "x ∈ stabl state"
    using well_infl_stabl_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate]
    by auto
  moreover have "(∀x ∈ stabl state. eq T x (σ state) ≤ (σ state) (Inl x)
      ∧ sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state) ≤ σ state)"
  proof -
    have "∀x∈stabl state. eq T x (σ state) ≤ σ state (Inl x) ∧
          sides_of_rhs (T x) (σ state) ≤ case_sum (λx. ⊥) (λg. rho_lookup (ρ ug_state) g x)"
        "case_sum (λx. ⊥) (λg. rho_lookup (ρ ug_state) g u) ≤ σ state" for u
      using partial_solution_ind(2)[OF assms(1)[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate] c_empty well_init
        init_rho_leq_bot
      unfolding init_state_def
      by (auto simp add: le_fun_def split: sum.splits)
    then show ?thesis
      by (auto intro: order.trans[of _ "case_sum (λx. ⊥) (λg. rho_lookup (ρ ug_state) g _)"])
  qed
  moreover have "∀u ∈ stabl state. dep⇩L T (σ state) u ⊆ stabl state"
    using TD_side.well_infl_stabl_implies_stabl_c_closed[OF well_result_state] c_empty
    unfolding TD_side.well_infl_stabl_def dep⇩L_def
    by simp
  ultimately show ?thesis using x_stabl st sigma by simp
qed


subsection ‹Program Refinement for Code Generation›

text‹To derive executable code for the TD, we do a program refinement and define an
  equivalent solve function based on partial\_function with options that can be used for the code
  generation.›

datatype ('a,'b,'c :: "{bounded_semilattice_sup_bot,warrowing}",'u) func_state =
    Q "'a × 'a × ('a,'b,'c) state × ('a,'b,'c,'u) ug_state_scheme"
  | I "'a × ('a,'b,'c) state × ('a,'b,'c,'u) ug_state_scheme"
  | R "'a × ('a,'b,'c) state × ('a,'b,'c,'u) ug_state_scheme"
  | E "'a × ('a,'b,'c) strategy_tree × ('b ⇒ 'c) × ('a,'b,'c) state ×
      ('a,'b,'c,'u) ug_state_scheme"

partial_function (option) solve_rec_c ::
  "('x,'g,'d,'upd) func_state ⇒ ('d × ('x,'g,'d) state × ('x,'g,'d,'upd) ug_state_scheme) option"
  where
  "solve_rec_c s = (case s of Q (y,x,state,ug_state) ⇒ Option.bind (
      if x ∈ called state then
        Some ((σ state) (Inl x), state⦇ point := insert x (point state) ⦈, ug_state)
      else
        solve_rec_c (I (x, state⦇ called := insert x (called state) ⦈, ug_state)))
      (λ (xd, state, ug_state). Some (xd, state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inl x) y⦈, ug_state))
  | I (x,state,ug_state) ⇒
      if x ∉ stabl state then Option.bind (
        solve_rec_c (R (x, state, ug_state)))
        (λ(d_new, state1, ug_state1).
          let d_new = (if x ∈ point state then (σ state1) (Inl x) ∇Δ d_new else d_new) in
          if (σ state1) (Inl x) = d_new then
            Some (d_new, state1⦇ called := called state1 - {x}, point := (point state1) - {x}⦈, ug_state1)
          else
            let (infl1, stabl1) = destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1) in
            solve_rec_c (I (x, state1⦇ infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
              σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := d_new) ⦈, ug_state1)))
      else
        Some ((σ state) (Inl x), state⦇ called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈, ug_state)
  | R (x, state, ug_state) ⇒ Option.bind (
      solve_rec_c (E (x, T x, (λ_. ⊥), state ⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈, ug_state)))
      (λ (xd, state, ug_state). if x ∈ stabl state then Some (xd, state, ug_state)
        else solve_rec_c (R (x, state, ug_state)))
  | E (x,t,sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,state,ug_state) ⇒ (case t of
        Answer d ⇒ Some (d, state, ug_state)
      | QueryL y g ⇒ (
          Option.bind (solve_rec_c (Q (x, y, state, ug_state))) (λ(yd, state, ug_state).
          solve_rec_c (E (x, g yd, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state))))
      | QueryG y g ⇒ (
          solve_rec_c (E (x, g ((σ state) (Inr y)), sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,
            state⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈, ug_state)))
      | Side y d t ⇒ (
          let d = sides⇩a⇩c⇩c y ⊔ d in
          let sides⇩a⇩c⇩c = sides⇩a⇩c⇩c(y := d) in
          let (upd,ug_state) = update_global (σ state (Inr y)) x y d ug_state in
          case upd of None ⇒ solve_rec_c (E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state))
          | Some d ⇒
            let (infl', stabl') = destab_opt (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state) in
            solve_rec_c (E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state⦇ infl := infl', stabl := stabl',
              σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d)⦈, ug_state)))
      ))"

definition solve_rec_c_dom where "solve_rec_c_dom p ≡ ∃σ. solve_rec_c p = Some σ"

declare solve_rec_c.simps[simp,code]

definition solve_c :: "'x ⇒ ('x set × (('x + 'g => 'd))) option" where
  "solve_c x = Option.bind (solve_rec_c
    (I (x, init_state⦇ called := insert x (called (init_state :: ('x,'g,'d) state)) ⦈, init_ug_state)))
    (λ(_, state, _). Some (stabl state, σ state))"

definition solve_c_dom :: "'x ⇒ bool" where
  "solve_c_dom x ≡ ∃r. solve_c x = Some r"

text‹We prove the equivalence of the refined solver function for code generation and the initial
  version used for the partial correctness proof.›

lemma query_iterate_eval_solve_rec_c_equiv:
  shows "query_dom x y state ug_state ⟹ solve_rec_c_dom (Q (x,y,state,ug_state))
    ∧ query x y state ug_state = the (solve_rec_c (Q (x,y,state,ug_state)))"
  and "iterate_dom x state ug_state ⟹ solve_rec_c_dom (I (x,state,ug_state))
    ∧ iterate x state ug_state = the (solve_rec_c (I (x,state,ug_state)))"
  and "repeat_dom x state ug_state ⟹ solve_rec_c_dom (R (x,state,ug_state))
    ∧ repeat x state ug_state = the (solve_rec_c (R (x,state,ug_state)))"
  and "eval_dom x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state ⟹ solve_rec_c_dom (E (x,t,sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,state,ug_state))
    ∧ eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = the (solve_rec_c (E (x,t,sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,state,ug_state)))"
proof (induction x y state ug_state and x state ug_state and x state ug_state
      and x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state
    rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state ug_state)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "y ∈ called state")
    case True
    then have "solve_rec_c (Q (x, y, state, ug_state))
        = Some ((σ state) (Inl y), state⦇ point := insert y (point state),
          infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inl y) x ⦈, ug_state)"
      by simp
    moreover have "query x y state ug_state = ((σ state) (Inl y),
        state⦇ point := insert y (point state),
          infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inl y) x ⦈, ug_state)"
      using query.psimps[folded dom_defs] Query(1) True by force
    ultimately show ?thesis unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
  next
    case False
    obtain d1 state1 ug_state1 where
        I: "iterate y (state⦇ called := insert y (called state) ⦈) ug_state = (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
      by (cases "iterate y (state⦇ called := insert y (called state) ⦈) ug_state") simp
    then have J: "query x y state ug_state =
        (d1, state1⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state1) (Inl y) x ⦈, ug_state1)"
      using False Query.IH(1) query.pelims[folded dom_defs] by fastforce
    then have "solve_rec_c (I (y, state⦇ called := insert y (called state) ⦈, ug_state)) =
        Some (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
      using Query(2) False I by (simp add: solve_rec_c_dom_def)
    then have "solve_rec_c (Q (x, y, state, ug_state)) =
        Some (d1, state1⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state1) (Inl y) x ⦈, ug_state1)"
      using False by simp
    moreover have "solve_rec_c_dom (Q (x, y, state, ug_state))"
      using Query(2) False unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by fastforce
    ultimately show ?thesis using Query J unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
  qed
next
  case (Iterate x state ug_state)
  show ?case
  proof (cases "x ∈ stabl state")
    case True
    have "iterate_dom x state ug_state ∧ iterate x state ug_state = ((σ state) (Inl x),
        state⦇ called := called state - {x}, point := (point state) - {x}⦈, ug_state)"
      using True iterate.psimps query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(2)
      unfolding iterate_dom_def
      by fastforce
    then show ?thesis using True unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
  next
    case False
    obtain d1 state1 ug_state1 where
        repeat: "repeat x state ug_state = (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
        "solve_rec_c (R (x, state, ug_state)) = Some (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
      using Iterate(2)[OF False, of "x ∈ point state"] unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
    define d' where "d' = (if x ∈ point state then (σ state1) (Inl x) ∇Δ d1 else d1)"
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "(σ state1) (Inl x) = d'")
      case True
      have "iterate x state ug_state =
          (d', state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := point state1 - {x}⦈, ug_state1)"
        using repeat iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF Iterate(1)] True False d'_def by simp
      moreover have "solve_rec_c (I (x, state, ug_state)) =
          Some (d', state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := point state1 - {x}⦈, ug_state1)"
        using repeat False True d'_def
        apply (subst solve_rec_c.simps)
        by (simp del: solve_rec_c.simps)
      ultimately show ?thesis unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
    next
      case False
      obtain infl2 stabl2 where
        destab: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)"
        by (cases "destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)") auto
      have "solve_rec_c_dom (I (x, state1⦇ infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := d') ⦈, ug_state1))"
        and "iterate x (state1⦇ infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := d') ⦈)
          ug_state1 =
          the (solve_rec_c (I (x, state1⦇ infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := d') ⦈, ug_state1)))"
        using Iterate(3)[OF ‹x ∉ stabl state› _ _ repeat(1)[symmetric] _ d'_def False destab]
        by blast+
      moreover have "iterate x state ug_state = iterate x (state1⦇ infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2,
          σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := d') ⦈) ug_state1"
        using repeat iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF Iterate(1)] False ‹x ∉ stabl state› destab
          d'_def
        by (cases "destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)") simp
      moreover have "solve_rec_c (I (x, state, ug_state)) =
          solve_rec_c (I (x, state1⦇infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := d')⦈,
          ug_state1))"
        using ‹x ∉ stabl state› False repeat(2) destab[symmetric] d'_def
        apply (subst solve_rec_c.simps)
        by (auto simp del: solve_rec_c.simps split: prod.splits)
      ultimately show ?thesis unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
    qed
  qed
next
  case (Repeat x state ug_state)
  obtain d1 state1 ug_state1 where
      eval: "eval x (T x) (λ_.⊥) (state ⦇ stabl := insert x (stabl state) ⦈) ug_state
        = (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
      "solve_rec_c (E (x, T x, λ_.⊥, state ⦇ stabl := insert x (stabl state) ⦈, ug_state))
        = Some (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
    using Repeat(2) unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
  show ?case
  proof (cases "x ∈ stabl state1")
    case True
    then show ?thesis
      using True repeat.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF Repeat(1)] eval
      unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
  next
    case False
    have "solve_rec_c_dom (R (x, state1, ug_state1))"
        "repeat x state1 ug_state1 = the (local.solve_rec_c (R (x, state1, ug_state1)))"
      using Repeat.IH(3)[OF eval(1)[symmetric] refl refl False] by auto
    then show ?thesis
      using False repeat.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF Repeat(1)] eval
      unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def
      by simp
  qed
next
  case (Eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state)
  show ?case
  proof (cases t)
    case (Answer d)
    then have "eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = (d, state, ug_state)"
      using eval.psimps query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4) dom_defs(4) by fastforce
    then show ?thesis using Eval Answer unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
  next
    case (QueryL y g)
    then obtain d1 state1 ug_state1 where
        query: "solve_rec_c (Q (x, y, state, ug_state)) = Some (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
          "query x y state ug_state = (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
      using QueryL Eval(2) unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by auto
    then have "solve_rec_c_dom (E (x, g d1, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state1, ug_state1))"
        "eval x (g d1) sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state1 ug_state1
          = the (solve_rec_c (E (x, g d1, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state1, ug_state1)))"
      using Eval(3)[OF QueryL] by auto
    moreover have "eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = eval x (g d1) sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state1 ug_state1"
      using Eval.IH(1) QueryL eval.psimps query unfolding eval_dom_def
      by fastforce
    moreover have "solve_rec_c (E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state))
        = solve_rec_c (E (x, g d1, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state1, ug_state1))"
      using QueryL query solve_rec_c.simps[of "E (x,t,sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,state,ug_state)"]
      by (simp del: solve_rec_c.simps)
    ultimately show ?thesis unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by force
  next
    case (QueryG y g)
    have "solve_rec_c_dom (E (x, g ((σ state) (Inr y)), sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,
          state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈, ug_state))"
        "eval x (g ((σ state) (Inr y))) sides⇩a⇩c⇩c (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈)
          ug_state = the (solve_rec_c (E (x, g ((σ state) (Inr y)), sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,
          state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈, ug_state)))"
      using Eval(4)[OF QueryG] by auto
    moreover have "eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = eval x (g ((σ state) (Inr y))) sides⇩a⇩c⇩c
        (state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈) ug_state"
      using Eval.IH(1) QueryG eval.psimps unfolding eval_dom_def
      by fastforce
    moreover have "solve_rec_c (E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)) = solve_rec_c (E (x,
        g ((σ state) (Inr y)), sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state⦇infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x⦈, ug_state))"
      using QueryG solve_rec_c.simps[of "E (x,t,sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,state,ug_state)"]
      by (simp del: solve_rec_c.simps)
    ultimately show ?thesis unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
  next
    case (Side y d t')
    let ?d = "sides⇩a⇩c⇩c y ⊔ d"
    let ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c = "sides⇩a⇩c⇩c(y := ?d)"
    obtain upd ug_state1 where
      upd_global: "(upd, ug_state1) = update_global (σ state (Inr y)) x y ?d ug_state"
      by (cases "update_global (σ state (Inr y)) x y ?d ug_state") auto
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases upd)
      case None
      have "solve_rec_c_dom (E (x, t', ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state1))"
          "eval x t' ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state1
            = the (solve_rec_c (E (x, t', ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state1)))"
        using Eval(5)[OF Side _ _ upd_global _ None] by auto
      moreover have "eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = eval x t' ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state1"
        using Eval.IH(1) Side None eval.psimps upd_global unfolding eval_dom_def
        by (auto simp add: Let_def split: prod.splits)
      moreover have "solve_rec_c (E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)) =
          solve_rec_c (E (x, t', ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state1))"
        using Side solve_rec_c.simps[of "E (x,t,sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,state,ug_state)"] None upd_global
        by (auto simp add: Let_def simp del: solve_rec_c.simps split: option.splits prod.splits)
      ultimately show ?thesis using Side unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
    next
      case (Some d')
      obtain infl1 stabl1 where
          destab: "(infl1, stabl1) = destab_opt (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)"
        by (cases "destab_opt (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)") simp
      let ?state' = "state ⦇ infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d') ⦈"
      have "solve_rec_c_dom (E (x, t', ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, ?state', ug_state1))"
          "eval x t' ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c ?state' ug_state1 =
            the (solve_rec_c (E (x, t', ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, ?state', ug_state1)))"
        using Eval(6)[OF Side refl refl upd_global _ Some destab]
        by (auto simp del: solve_rec_c.simps)
      moreover have "eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = eval x t' ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c ?state' ug_state1"
        using Eval.IH(1) Side Some eval.psimps destab upd_global unfolding eval_dom_def
        by (auto simp add: Let_def split: option.splits prod.splits)
      moreover have
        "solve_rec_c (E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)) =
          solve_rec_c (E (x, t', ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, ?state', ug_state1))"
        using Side solve_rec_c.simps[of "E (x,t,sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,state,ug_state)"] Some destab upd_global
        by (auto simp add: Let_def split: prod.split)
      ultimately show ?thesis using Side unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma solve_rec_c_query_iterate_eval_equiv:
  shows "solve_rec_c s = Some r ⟹ (case s of
        Q (x,y,state,ug_state) ⇒ query_dom x y state ug_state ∧ query x y state ug_state = r
      | I (x,state,ug_state) ⇒ iterate_dom x state ug_state ∧ iterate x state ug_state = r
      | R (x,state,ug_state) ⇒ repeat_dom x state ug_state ∧ repeat x state ug_state = r
      | E (x,t,sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,state,ug_state) ⇒ eval_dom x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state ∧
          eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = r)"
proof (induction arbitrary: s r rule: solve_rec_c.fixp_induct)
  case 1
  then show ?case
    by (smt (verit) ccpo.admissibleI chain_fun curry_def flat_lub_in_chain fun_lub_def
        mem_Collect_eq option.simps(3))
next
  case 2
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (3 S)
  show ?case
  proof (cases s)
    case (Q a)
    obtain x y state ug_state where "a = (x, y, state, ug_state)" using prod_cases4 by blast
    have "query_dom x y state ug_state ∧ query x y state ug_state = r"
    proof (cases "y ∈ called state")
      case True
      then have "Some ((σ state) (Inl y), state ⦇ point := insert y (point state),
          infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inl y) x ⦈, ug_state) = Some r"
        using 3(2) Q ‹a = (x, y, state, ug_state)› by simp
      then show ?thesis using query.psimps[folded query_dom_def, of x y state]
            query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(1)[folded query_dom_def, of y state] True by simp
    next
      case False
      then have "Option.bind (S (I (y, state ⦇ called := insert y (called state) ⦈, ug_state)))
          (λ(d,state, ug_state). Some (d, state ⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inl y) x ⦈,
          ug_state)) = Some r"
        using 3(2) Q ‹a = (x, y, state, ug_state)› by simp
      then obtain d1 state1 ug_state1 where
        "S (I (y, state ⦇ called := insert y (called state) ⦈, ug_state)) = Some (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
        and "(d1, state1 ⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state1) (Inl y) x ⦈, ug_state1) = r"
        by (cases "S (I (y, state ⦇ called := insert y (called state) ⦈, ug_state))") auto
      then have "iterate_dom y (state ⦇ called := insert y (called state) ⦈) ug_state
          ∧ iterate y (state ⦇ called := insert y (called state) ⦈) ug_state = (d1, state1, ug_state1)"
        using 3(1) unfolding iterate_dom_def by fastforce
      then show ?thesis
        using False ‹(d1, state1 ⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state1) (Inl y) x ⦈, ug_state1) = r›
        by (simp add: query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(1) False)
    qed
    then show ?thesis using Q ‹a = (x, y, state, ug_state)› by simp
  next
    case (I a)
    obtain x state ug_state where "a = (x, state, ug_state)"
      using repeat.cases by blast
    show ?thesis
    proof(cases "x ∈ stabl state")
      case True
      then have "((σ state) (Inl x),
          state⦇called := called state - {x}, point := point state - {x}⦈, ug_state) = r"
        using I ‹a = (x, state, ug_state)› 3(2) by simp
      moreover have "iterate_dom x state ug_state ∧ iterate x state ug_state = ((σ state) (Inl x),
          state⦇called := called state - {x}, point := point state - {x}⦈, ug_state)"
        using True query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(2) iterate.psimps dom_defs by fastforce
      ultimately show ?thesis using I ‹a = (x, state, ug_state)› by simp
    next
      case False
      then have IH1: "Option.bind (S (R (x, state, ug_state)))
         (λ(d_new, state1, ug_state1).
           let d_new = if x ∈ point state then (σ state1) (Inl x) ∇Δ d_new else d_new in
           if (σ state1) (Inl x) = d_new then
            Some (d_new, state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := point state1 - {x}⦈, ug_state1)
           else let (infl1, stabl1) = destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1) in
            S (I (x, state1⦇ infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1,
            σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := d_new) ⦈, ug_state1))) = Some r"
        using 3(2) I ‹a = (x, state, ug_state)› by simp
      then obtain d_new state1 ug_state1
        where repeat_some: "S (R (x, state, ug_state)) = Some (d_new, state1, ug_state1)"
        using 3(2) I
        by (cases "S (R (x, state, ug_state))") auto
      then have repeat: "repeat_dom x state ug_state
          ∧ repeat x state ug_state = (d_new, state1, ug_state1)"
        using 3(1) unfolding repeat_dom_def by force
      let ?d_new = "if x ∈ point state then (σ state1) (Inl x) ∇Δ d_new else d_new"
      have "iterate_dom x state ug_state ∧ iterate x state ug_state = r"
      proof (cases "(σ state1) (Inl x) = ?d_new")
        case True
        then have
          "(?d_new, state1⦇called := called state1 - {x}, point := point state1 - {x}⦈, ug_state1) = r"
          using IH1 repeat_some by simp
        moreover have "iterate_dom x state ug_state"
          using query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs] False True repeat
          by fastforce
        ultimately show ?thesis
          using iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs] False True repeat by fastforce
      next
        case False
        obtain infl2 stabl2 where
            destab: "(infl2, stabl2) = destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)"
          by (cases "destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)") auto
        let ?state = "state1⦇ infl := infl2, stabl := stabl2, σ := (σ state1)(Inl x := ?d_new) ⦈"
        have "S (I (x, ?state, ug_state1)) = Some r"
          using IH1 False repeat_some destab
          by (cases "destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)") simp
        then have iter_cont: "iterate_dom x ?state ug_state1 ∧ iterate x ?state ug_state1 = r"
          using 3(1) unfolding iterate_dom_def by fastforce
        then have "iterate_dom x state ug_state"
          using query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(2)[folded dom_defs destab.simps, of x state]
            repeat ‹x ∉ stabl state› False destab
          by (cases "destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)") fastforce
        then show ?thesis
          using iterate.psimps[folded dom_defs, of x state] ‹x ∉ stabl state› destab repeat
            False iter_cont
          by (cases "destab_opt (Inl x) (infl state1) (stabl state1) (called state1)") auto
      qed
      then show ?thesis
        using I ‹a = (x, state, ug_state)› by simp
    qed
  next
    case (R a)
    obtain x state ug_state where "a = (x, state, ug_state)"
      using repeat.cases by blast
    then have IH1: "Option.bind
        (S (E (x, T x, λ_. ⊥, state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈, ug_state)))
        (λa. case a of
             (xd, state, ug_state) ⇒
               if x ∈ stabl state then Some (xd, state, ug_state)
               else S (R (x, state, ug_state))) = Some r"
      using 3(2) R by simp
    then obtain d_new state1 ug_state1 where eval_some:
      "S (E (x, T x, λ_. ⊥, state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈, ug_state)) =
        Some (d_new, state1, ug_state1)"
      using 3(2) R
      by (cases "S (E (x, T x, λ_. ⊥, state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈, ug_state))") auto
    then have eval: "eval_dom x (T x) (λ_. ⊥) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) ug_state ∧
        eval x (T x) (λ_. ⊥) (state⦇stabl := insert x (stabl state)⦈) ug_state =
          (d_new, state1, ug_state1)"
      using 3(1) unfolding repeat_dom_def by force
    show ?thesis
    proof(cases "x ∈ stabl state1")
      case True
      then have "(d_new, state1, ug_state1) = r"
        using R ‹a = (x, state, ug_state)› 3(2) eval_some by simp
      moreover have "repeat_dom x state ug_state ∧
        repeat x state ug_state = (d_new, state1, ug_state1)"
        using True query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(3) repeat.psimps dom_defs eval
        by fastforce
      ultimately show ?thesis using R ‹a = (x, state, ug_state)› by simp
    next
      case False
      have "S (R (x, state1, ug_state1)) = Some r"
        using IH1 False eval_some by simp
      then have repeat_cont: "repeat_dom x state1 ug_state1 ∧ repeat x state1 ug_state1 = r"
        using 3(1) unfolding repeat_dom_def by fastforce
      then have "repeat_dom x state ug_state"
        apply (intro query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(3)[folded dom_defs, of x state])
        using eval False by simp+
      then show ?thesis
        using repeat.psimps[folded dom_defs, of x state] ‹x ∉ stabl state1› eval
          False repeat_cont R ‹a = (x, state, ug_state)›
        by simp
    qed
  next
    case (E a)
    obtain x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state where "a = (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)"
      using prod_cases5 by blast
    then have "s = E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)" using E by auto
    have "eval_dom x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state ∧ eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = r"
    proof (cases t)
      case (Answer d)
      then have "eval_dom x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state"
        unfolding eval_dom_def
        using query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)
        by fastforce
      moreover have "eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state = (d, state, ug_state)"
        using Answer eval.psimps[folded dom_defs, OF calculation] by auto
      moreover have "(d, state, ug_state) = r"
        using 3(2) ‹s = E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)› Answer by simp
      ultimately show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case (QueryL y g)
      then have "Option.bind (S (Q (x, y, state, ug_state))) (λ(yd, state, ug_state).
          S (E (x, g yd, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state))) = Some r"
        using ‹s = E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)› 3(2) by simp
      then obtain yd state1 ug_state1
          where S1: "S (Q (x, y, state, ug_state)) = Some (yd, state1, ug_state1)"
          and S2: "S (E (x, g yd, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state1, ug_state1)) = Some r"
        by (cases "S (Q (x, y, state, ug_state))") auto
      then have "query_dom x y state ug_state
            ∧ query x y state ug_state = (yd, state1, ug_state1)"
          and "eval_dom x (g yd) sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state1 ug_state1
            ∧ eval x (g yd) sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state1 ug_state1 = r"
        using 3(1)[OF S1] 3(1)[OF S2] by force+
      then show ?thesis
        using query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[of t x state] QueryL eval.psimps[of x t]
        unfolding dom_defs by fastforce
    next
      case (QueryG y g)
      then have E_cont: "S (E (x, g ((σ state) (Inr y)), sides⇩a⇩c⇩c,
          state⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x ⦈, ug_state)) = Some r"
        using ‹s = E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)› 3(2) by simp
      have "eval_dom x (g ((σ state) (Inr y))) sides⇩a⇩c⇩c
          (state⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x ⦈) ug_state ∧
          eval x (g ((σ state) (Inr y))) sides⇩a⇩c⇩c
          (state⦇ infl := fminsert (infl state) (Inr y) x ⦈) ug_state = r"
        using 3(1)[OF E_cont] by simp
      then show ?thesis
        using query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[of t x state] QueryG eval.psimps[of x t]
        unfolding dom_defs by fastforce
    next
      case (Side y d t')
      let ?d = "sides⇩a⇩c⇩c y ⊔ d"
      let ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c = "sides⇩a⇩c⇩c(y := ?d)"
      obtain upd ug_state1 where
        upd_global: "(upd, ug_state1) = update_global (σ state (Inr y)) x y ?d ug_state"
        by (cases "update_global (σ state (Inr y)) x y ?d ug_state") fastforce
      show ?thesis
      proof (cases upd)
        case None
        then have E_cont: "S (E (x, t', ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state1)) = Some r"
          using ‹s = E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)› 3(2) Side upd_global
          by (auto simp add: Let_def split: prod.splits option.splits)
        have "eval_dom x t' ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state1 ∧ eval x t' ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state1 = r"
          using 3(1)[OF E_cont] by simp
        then show ?thesis
          using query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[of t x state ug_state sides⇩a⇩c⇩c] Side
            eval.psimps[of x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state] upd_global[simplified None]
          unfolding dom_defs
          by (cases "update_global (σ state (Inr y)) x y ?d ug_state") fastforce
      next
        case (Some d')
        obtain infl1 stabl1 where
          destab: "(infl1, stabl1) = destab_opt (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)"
          by (cases "destab_opt (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)") simp
        let ?state = "state⦇ infl := infl1, stabl := stabl1, σ := (σ state)(Inr y := d') ⦈"
        have E_cont: "S (E (x, t', ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, ?state, ug_state1)) = Some r"
          using ‹s = E (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)› 3(2) Side Some destab upd_global
          by (auto simp add: Let_def split: option.splits prod.splits)
        have "eval_dom x t' ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c ?state ug_state1 ∧ eval x t' ?sides⇩a⇩c⇩c ?state ug_state1 = r"
          using 3(1)[OF E_cont] by simp
        then show ?thesis
          using query_iterate_repeat_eval.domintros(4)[of t x state ug_state sides⇩a⇩c⇩c] Side Some
            destab eval.psimps[of x _ sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state] upd_global
          unfolding dom_defs
          by (cases "update_global (σ state (Inr y)) x y ?d ug_state";
              cases "destab_opt (Inr y) (infl state) (stabl state) (called state)") fastforce
      qed
    qed
    then show ?thesis using E ‹a = (x, t, sides⇩a⇩c⇩c, state, ug_state)› by simp
  qed
qed

theorem term_equivalence: "solve_dom x ⟷ solve_c_dom x"
  using solve_rec_c_query_iterate_eval_equiv[of "I (x, init_state⦇ called :=
    insert x (called init_state) ⦈, init_ug_state)"] query_iterate_eval_solve_rec_c_equiv(2)[of x
    "init_state⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈" init_ug_state]
  unfolding solve_dom_def solve_c_dom_def solve_rec_c_dom_def solve_c_def init_state_def
  apply (cases "solve_rec_c (I (x, init_state⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈, init_ug_state))")
  by (auto simp add: init_state_def init_rho_leq_bot)

theorem value_equivalence:
  "solve_dom x ⟹ ∃stabl σ. solve_c x = Some (stabl, σ) ∧ solve x = (stabl, σ)"
proof goal_cases
  case 1
  then obtain r where "solve_rec_c (I
    (x, init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈, init_ug_state)) = Some r
    ∧ iterate x (init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈) init_ug_state = r"
    using query_iterate_eval_solve_rec_c_equiv(2)[OF 1[unfolded solve_dom_def]]
    unfolding solve_rec_c_dom_def solve_dom_def init_state_def
    by fastforce
  then show ?case
    unfolding solve_c_def solve_def init_state_def by (auto split: prod.split)
qed

text‹With the equivalence of the refined version and the initial version proven, we can specify a
  code equation.›

lemma solve_code_equation [code]:
  "solve x = (case solve_c x of Some r ⇒ r
  | None ⇒ Code.abort (STR ''Input not in domain'') (λ_. solve x))"
proof (cases "solve_dom x")
  case True
  then show ?thesis
    using value_equivalence unfolding solve_c_def solve_def by fastforce
next
  case False
  then have "solve_c x = None" using term_equivalence
    unfolding solve_c_dom_def by (simp split: option.splits) fast
  then show ?thesis by auto
qed

subsection ‹Consequences of Termination›

text ‹An executable run that returns a result lies in the solver domain, so the partial
  correctness theorem applies to it.›

lemma solve_dom_of_solve_c:
  assumes "solve_c x ≠ None"
  shows "solve_dom x"
  unfolding term_equivalence solve_c_dom_def using assms by (cases "solve_c x") auto

lemma part_post_solution_of_solve_c:
  assumes "solve_c x ≠ None"
  shows "part_post_solution T x (snd (solve x)) (fst (solve x))"
proof -
  from partial_post_solution[OF solve_dom_of_solve_c[OF assms], of "fst (solve x)" "snd (solve x)"]
  show ?thesis by simp
qed

text ‹A terminating solve returns a finite stable set. The stable set changes in three places:
  ‹repeat› inserts one unknown, and ‹iterate› and the side-effect case of ‹eval› replace
  it by a \<^const>‹destab_opt› result, which is a subset of its input.›

lemma finite_stabl_ind:
  shows "query_dom x y state ug_state
    ⟹ (xd, state', ug_state') = query x y state ug_state
    ⟹ finite (stabl state) ⟹ finite (stabl state')"
    and "iterate_dom x state ug_state
    ⟹ (xd, state', ug_state') = iterate x state ug_state
    ⟹ finite (stabl state) ⟹ finite (stabl state')"
    and "repeat_dom x state ug_state
    ⟹ (xd, state', ug_state') = repeat x state ug_state
    ⟹ finite (stabl state) ⟹ finite (stabl state')"
    and "eval_dom x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state
    ⟹ (xd, state', ug_state') = eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state
    ⟹ finite (stabl state) ⟹ finite (stabl state')"
proof (induction x y state ug_state and x state ug_state and x state ug_state
        and x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state
      arbitrary: xd state' ug_state' and xd state' ug_state' and xd state' ug_state'
        and xd state' ug_state'
      rule: query_iterate_repeat_eval_pinduct)
  case (Query x y state ug_state)
  then show ?case
    by (auto simp: query.psimps[OF Query(1)[unfolded query_dom_def]]
        split: if_splits prod.splits)
next
  case (Iterate x state ug_state)
  then show ?case
    by (auto simp: iterate.psimps[OF Iterate(1)[unfolded iterate_dom_def]] Let_def
        split: if_splits prod.splits dest: destab_opt_stabl_finite)
next
  case (Repeat x state ug_state)
  then show ?case
    by (auto simp: repeat.psimps[OF Repeat(1)[unfolded repeat_dom_def]] Let_def
        split: if_splits prod.splits)
next
  case (Eval x t sides⇩a⇩c⇩c state ug_state)
  text ‹‹Side› is the one shape whose recursive call moves to a destabilized
    state, so its induction hypothesis wants finiteness of a set ‹auto› has not
    yet related to ‹stabl state›. Supplying that link with this case's own
    finiteness already discharged keeps it a one-premise ‹dest› rule, which
    leaves the ‹destab_opt› equation in place for the hypothesis itself.›
  from Eval have fin: "finite (stabl state)" by blast
  have fin_destab: "⋀y i' s'.
      destab_opt y (infl state) (stabl state) (called state) = (i', s') ⟹ finite s'"
    using fin destab_opt_stabl_finite by blast
  from Eval fin_destab show ?case
    by (auto simp: eval.psimps[OF Eval(1)[unfolded eval_dom_def]] Let_def
        split: if_splits prod.splits option.splits strategy_tree.splits)
qed

lemma finite_stabl_solve:
  assumes "solve_dom x"
  shows "finite (fst (solve x))"
proof -
  obtain d state ug_state where iterate: "(d, state, ug_state) =
      iterate x (init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈) init_ug_state"
    by (cases "iterate x (init_state ⦇ called := insert x (called init_state) ⦈) init_ug_state")
      auto
  have "fst (solve x) = stabl state"
    using iterate unfolding solve_def by (auto split: prod.splits)
  moreover have "finite (stabl state)"
    using finite_stabl_ind(2)[OF assms[unfolded solve_dom_def] iterate]
    unfolding init_state_def by simp
  ultimately show ?thesis by simp
qed
